Context: 9. Restrictions regarding marriage

## 9. Restrictions regarding marriage  
[ Swamy's CCS (Conduct) Rules]  
1. Before appointment.Bigamous marriage being a disqualification, the following persons are ineligible for appointment under Government:-
2. (a) Who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or  
- Who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted
- (b) a marriage with any person.
